title: MoE Router topk=1 with post-softmax gives trivial probabilities and zero gradient
root_cause: topk-then-softmax with k=1: softmax of single value is always 1.0, producing zero gradient for the router. Router weights never learn.
invariant: Router routing probabilities must have non-trivial distribution. All probs == 1.0 means zero gradient = bug.

expected_output.buggy: BUG DETECTED: all routing probs are 1.0 (trivial softmax)
expected_output.fixed: ValueError: Please use --moe-router-pre-softmax when topk is 1.
